weaknesses: Needs 25+ minutes of farm to be effective
Anti-Mage.laning_tips: Focus on survival and last hits above all else. Use Blink to escape ganks but watch mana. Counterspell can reflect key spells if timed correctly. Rush Battle Fury to accelerate farm.
Anti-Mage.level1_note: Mana Break at level 1 is weak. Melee hero with no disable or burst — minimal level 1 fight contribution.

weaknesses: Countered hard by MKB (true strike ignores her evasion)
Needs her Immaterial evasion to survive — useless vs true strike
Phantom Assassin.laning_tips: Use Stifling Dagger for ranged last hits and harass. Phantom Strike onto enemies then immediately Dagger for the slow. After level 6, crits give kill potential. Watch for enemy disables before committing.
Phantom Assassin.level1_note: Stifling Dagger provides ranged slow but mediocre damage. Melee hero lacks level 1 fight capability.

weaknesses: Omnislash bounces split by nearby creeps
Healing Ward is fragile and easily destroyed
Juggernaut.laning_tips: Blade Fury provides magic immunity and high AoE damage — combine with support stuns for early kills. Healing Ward sustains through trades. High base damage makes last-hitting easy. Keep creep waves clear before using Omnislash.
Juggernaut.level1_note: Blade Fury provides magic immunity + high AoE damage at level 1 — extremely strong kill potential with allies.

weaknesses: One of the weakest laning carries
Spectre.laning_tips: Survive the lane at all costs. Use Spectral Dagger for escape and to chase through terrain. Desolate deals pure damage when enemy is isolated — look for solo targets. Dispersion returns damage but you still need HP to survive.
Spectre.level1_note: Spectral Dagger provides a slow and pathing but low damage. Very weak level 1 fighter.

Wraith King.laning_tips: Wraithfire Blast is a reliable stun for kill setups. Vampiric Spirit provides sustain through lifesteal. Skeleton summons help push and farm. With Reincarnation you can play aggressively — enemies must kill you twice.
Wraith King.level1_note: Wraithfire Blast provides a reliable targeted stun + slow — strong in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Eclipse damage splits — weak vs grouped enemies near creeps
Luna.laning_tips: Lucent Beam harasses and secures last hits. Moon Glaives bounce makes farming fast but pushes lane — be aware of wave equilibrium. Lunar Blessing aura boosts ally damage. Eclipse at level 6 gives massive kill potential in 1v1 or 2v1.
Luna.level1_note: Lucent Beam provides a mini-stun and magic damage — decent in level 1 engagements.

weaknesses: Countered by AoE damage and cleave
Illusions die quickly to magic damage
Needs Diffusal Blade to fight effectively
Phantom Lancer.laning_tips: Spirit Lance harasses from range and creates an illusion for scouting. Doppelganger dodges spells and creates confusion. Phantom Rush closes gaps on enemies. Farm Diffusal Blade as first major item to enable fighting with mana burn illusions.
Phantom Lancer.level1_note: Spirit Lance provides a ranged slow but low overall damage contribution in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Weak laning against aggressive dual lanes
Low HP pool throughout the game
Countered by AoE reveals and detection
Slark.laning_tips: Essence Shift steals stats with each attack — extended trades favor Slark. Pounce leashes enemies preventing escape. Dark Pact purges debuffs after a delay — time it to remove stuns. Shadow Dance at 6 makes you nearly unkillable in skirmishes.
Slark.level1_note: Essence Shift needs multiple attacks to matter. No burst or disable at level 1.

weaknesses: Extremely vulnerable when morphed to full agility
Morph can be interrupted by stuns
Requires high mechanical skill to play effectively
Morphling.laning_tips: Start with stats shifted toward strength for lane survivability. Waveform is an escape and damage nuke. Adaptive Strike stuns when strength is higher or nukes when agility is higher. Morph back to strength if caught — but stuns interrupt the shift.
Morphling.level1_note: Waveform provides a short dash and damage but Morphling is fragile and has no disable at level 1.

weaknesses: Battle Trance forces commitment — cannot retreat
Troll Warlord.laning_tips: Toggle between melee (more damage, bash chance) and ranged (safer harass, Whirling Axes slow). Fervor stacks attack speed when hitting the same target. Battle Trance at 6 gives insane attack speed — use it to commit to kills or Roshan.
Troll Warlord.level1_note: Whirling Axes (ranged) provides AoE slow; melee form has Whirling Axes blind. Decent level 1 flexibility.

weaknesses: Mana-dependent for survivability via Mana Shield
Medusa.laning_tips: Mystic Snake bounces and steals mana — use it to harass and sustain mana. Split Shot helps farm but pushes the lane. Mana Shield makes you deceptively tanky. Stone Gaze at 6 is a defensive/offensive teamfight tool. Focus on farming efficiency.
Medusa.level1_note: Mystic Snake provides some harass but Medusa has no fight presence at level 1.

Lifestealer.laning_tips: Feast provides built-in lifesteal based on enemy max HP — trade aggressively against high-HP heroes. Rage grants magic immunity allowing free hits. Open Wounds slows and amplifies damage. Infest inside allied initiators for surprise engagements.
Lifestealer.level1_note: Feast provides strong sustain and damage in melee trades. Good base stats as a Strength hero.

weaknesses: Falls off against BKBs late game
Bloodseeker.laning_tips: Bloodrage amplifies your damage and healing from last hits — keep it active. Thirst gives vision and speed on low HP enemies. Blood Rite provides AoE silence after a delay. Rupture punishes mobile heroes — force them to stand still or take massive damage.
Bloodseeker.level1_note: Bloodrage provides damage amp and healing from last hits, decent sustain but no fight contribution.

weaknesses: Bad Chronosphere catches allies and loses fights
Faceless Void.laning_tips: Time Walk lets you escape and reverses recent damage taken. Focus on farming, not fighting pre-6. Chronosphere at 6 with ally follow-up wins teamfights. Be very careful with Chrono placement — it stops allies too.
Faceless Void.level1_note: Time Walk is only useful for escape — no damage or disable at level 1.

weaknesses: Marksmanship disabled when enemies are close
Low HP pool throughout the game
Drow Ranger.laning_tips: Use ranged advantage to secure last hits safely. Frost Arrows harass and slow — use them to kite melee heroes. Keep distance at all costs — Marksmanship disables in close range. Multishot clears waves and camps quickly.
Drow Ranger.level1_note: Frost Arrows provide slow and bonus damage, useful for level 1 chasing and kiting.

weaknesses: Illusions die to AoE quickly early
Terrorblade.laning_tips: Metamorphosis turns you ranged with bonus damage — trade aggressively during it. Conjure Image creates strong illusions for farming and pushing. Reflection slows and creates enemy illusions. Sunder swaps HP percentages — a powerful survival tool at low health.
Terrorblade.level1_note: Metamorphosis at level 1 provides ranged attacks with bonus damage — decent trading power.

weaknesses: Countered hard by AoE damage clearing illusions
Chaos Knight.laning_tips: Chaos Bolt stun duration is random (1-4s) — use it to set up kills. Reality Rift pulls you and the target together and reduces armor. Chaos Strike crits give sustain. Phantasm illusions at 6 give enormous burst when focused on one target.
Chaos Knight.level1_note: Chaos Bolt provides a targeted stun with potential for long duration — strong in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Mechanically demanding — must control two units
Weak when bear is on cooldown
Lone Druid.laning_tips: Spirit Bear is your main damage dealer — itemize the bear first. Bear has Entangle root on attacks. Use True Form for tankiness in fights. Keep the bear within leash range or it cannot attack. Can push towers early with bear.
Lone Druid.level1_note: Spirit Bear provides an extra unit with Entangle root chance — very strong level 1 with double attack sources.

weaknesses: Falls off late game despite farm advantage
Alchemist.laning_tips: Acid Spray zones enemies and accelerates farm. Greevil's Greed bonus gold makes every last hit count — prioritize farm efficiency. Chemical Rage at 6 gives massive HP regen making you hard to kill. Unstable Concoction stuns but can backfire if not thrown.
Alchemist.level1_note: Acid Spray provides AoE armor reduction but needs time to deal damage. No disable at level 1.

weaknesses: Weak against disarms and ghost scepters
Ursa.laning_tips: Fury Swipes stack damage rapidly on a single target — commit to one enemy. Earthshock slows in an AoE. Overpower gives burst attack speed for quick Fury Swipes stacking. Can solo Roshan very early with Fury Swipes + Overpower. Enrage dispels and reduces damage.
Ursa.level1_note: Fury Swipes stacking damage makes Ursa one of the strongest level 1 melee fighters.

weaknesses: Rocket Barrage requires being close to target
Falls off without items late game
Gyrocopter.laning_tips: Rocket Barrage deals massive single-target damage if you're close — pair with support stuns. Homing Missile provides a long-range stun. Flak Cannon hits all enemies in range for a few attacks. Call Down provides AoE slow and damage for teamfights.
Gyrocopter.level1_note: Rocket Barrage at close range deals enormous damage at level 1 — very strong kill potential with stun support.

weaknesses: No gap closer besides Warcry speed
Sven.laning_tips: Storm Hammer is a reliable AoE stun for kill setups. Great Cleave farms stacked camps extremely fast. Warcry provides armor and movement speed. God's Strength at 6 doubles your damage — look for fights with stun ready.
Sven.level1_note: Storm Hammer provides AoE stun with decent damage — strong level 1 disable.

weaknesses: Double can be killed for gold
Arc Warden.laning_tips: Flux deals damage and slows isolated targets — useless when enemies are near allied units. Magnetic Field provides evasion and attack speed in an area. Spark Wraith scouts and deals damage. Tempest Double at 6 doubles all your items and abilities.
Arc Warden.level1_note: Flux is nullified by nearby units. No reliable damage or disable at level 1.

weaknesses: Tree Dance is countered by tree destruction
Jingu Mastery needs 4 hits to activate
Wukong's Command soldiers stand in a fixed ring
Monkey King.laning_tips: Boundless Strike crits and stuns in a line. Jingu Mastery gives massive bonus damage and lifesteal after 4 hits on the same target — commit to trades. Tree Dance provides mobility and vision. Wukong's Command at 6 creates a ring of soldier clones.
Monkey King.level1_note: Boundless Strike provides a crit + stun. Strong base damage and Jingu stacking makes level 1 trades favorable.

weaknesses: Low mobility — no dash or blink
Pierce the Veil makes you immune to physical but vulnerable to magic
Muerta.laning_tips: Dead Shot bounces off a target and fears them toward you. The Calling summons spirits that silence and slow in an area. Gunslinger gives extra shots passively. Pierce the Veil at 6 gives magic immunity from physical damage and converts attacks to magic.
Muerta.level1_note: Dead Shot provides a slow and fear mechanic — decent harassment at level 1.

weaknesses: Requires committing to fights with mobility skills
Kez.laning_tips: Kez carries two weapons and switches between them (Switch Discipline). With the katana, Grappling Claw is the gap closer and slow, Echo Slash the damage and Kazurai Katana a bleed with an impale; with the sai, Talon Toss silences, Falcon Rush chases and Shodo Sai parries attacks. Raptor Dance at 6 deals max-health damage around him and heals him. Play aggressively when the ultimate is available.
Kez.level1_note: Grappling Claw provides a gap closer with slow — average level 1 contribution.

weaknesses: Illusions are weak early and die to AoE
Song of the Siren can disrupt ally combos if mistimed
Naga Siren.laning_tips: Ensnare is a reliable root that goes through BKB — strong setup for kills. Mirror Image creates illusions for scouting and farming. Rip Tide reduces armor in AoE. Song of the Siren resets fights or sets up combos. Can flex between carry and support roles.
Naga Siren.level1_note: Ensnare provides a targeted root — decent disable for level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Loses all Necromastery souls on death
Shadow Fiend.laning_tips: Necromastery souls give bonus damage — every last hit matters, especially early. Shadowraze at three ranges lets you nuke and farm. Stack and clear jungle camps between waves. Presence of the Dark Lord reduces nearby enemy armor. Requiem deals more damage with more souls.
Shadow Fiend.level1_note: Starts with 0 Necromastery souls and very low base damage. One of the weakest level 1 heroes in the game.

weaknesses: Low HP pool — dies quickly if caught
Phase Shift root means you cannot move
Falls off in damage late game
Puck.laning_tips: Illusory Orb damages and provides a teleport — throw it then jaunt to it for escape or aggression. Waning Rift silences in AoE. Phase Shift dodges incoming projectiles and spells. Dream Coil at 6 leashes enemies — breaking the leash stuns.
Puck.level1_note: Illusory Orb provides AoE damage and an escape — decent level 1 contribution.

weaknesses: Blink has moderate cooldown early — punishable if wasted
Falls off in damage against tanky heroes late
Needs to snowball from mid game
Queen of Pain.laning_tips: Shadow Strike provides strong DoT harass in lane. Blink provides unmatched mobility — use it aggressively and to dodge spells. Scream of Pain is your main farming and fighting nuke. Sonic Wave at 6 is a massive AoE pure damage nuke.
Queen of Pain.level1_note: Shadow Strike provides decent DoT damage and slow at level 1.

Storm Spirit.laning_tips: Static Remnant and Overload proc harass enemies in lane. Last hit with Overload-charged attacks. Pre-6 focus on CS and rune control. Ball Lightning at 6 provides infinite mobility — zip in, combo (Remnant + Overload + Vortex), zip out. Watch mana carefully.
Storm Spirit.level1_note: Static Remnant has low damage and Storm has no mobility at level 1.

weaknesses: Refraction charges removed by DoT effects
Templar Assassin.laning_tips: Refraction blocks damage instances and adds bonus damage — trade aggressively with it up. Meld provides invisibility + armor reduction on the next attack. Psi Blades spill damage lets you harass through creeps. Place Psionic Traps for vision and slows.
Templar Assassin.level1_note: Refraction at level 1 gives bonus damage and damage block — very strong in 1v1 mid matchups.

weaknesses: Light Strike Array is slow and hard to land without setup
Needs Eul's for reliable stun setup
Lina.laning_tips: Dragon Slave farms waves and harasses. Fiery Soul stacks give attack and move speed — keep casting to maintain stacks. Light Strike Array stun is hard to land raw — use Eul's or ally setup. Laguna Blade at 6 gives massive single-target burst. Can also play as support.
Lina.level1_note: Dragon Slave provides decent AoE damage for level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Needs Fire Remnant charges for escape — vulnerable without them
Ember Spirit.laning_tips: Flame Guard absorbs magic damage and deals AoE — strong in melee matchups. Searing Chains roots nearby enemies randomly. Sleight of Fist hits all enemies in AoE from invulnerability. Fire Remnants at 6 provide global mobility — always keep one remnant in safety.
Ember Spirit.level1_note: Flame Guard provides magic shield and AoE damage — decent level 1 trading in melee range.

weaknesses: All mobility skills have significant cooldowns
Falls off in damage late game
Void Spirit.laning_tips: Resonant Pulse provides a damage-absorbing shield and AoE nuke — use it to trade. Aether Remnant creates a watchpoint that pulls and damages. Dissimilate dodges spells and repositions. Astral Step at 6 gives two charges of blink + slow. Combo: Astral in, Remnant, Pulse, Dissimilate out.
Void Spirit.level1_note: Resonant Pulse provides AoE damage and a shield — decent level 1 trading.

weaknesses: Rearm and Keen Conveyance are channeled and can be interrupted
Laser's blind does nothing against spell damage
Tinker.laning_tips: Laser blinds enemy and deals pure damage — win mid trades with it. March of the Machines farms waves and jungle. Keen Conveyance teleports Tinker to friendly structures (at higher levels to units and heroes), so he can push a lane and go back to the fountain for mana; Rearm resets his ability cooldowns.
Tinker.level1_note: Laser provides blind and pure damage — decent level 1 trading in mid.

weaknesses: Spirits return heal only after Exorcism ends
Death Prophet.laning_tips: Crypt Swarm clears waves and harasses. Spirit Siphon drains HP from enemies — you can maintain multiple siphons. Silence prevents enemy spell usage in an area. Exorcism at 6 shreds towers — push aggressively when it is active. Play around Exorcism cooldown.
Death Prophet.level1_note: Crypt Swarm provides AoE nuke damage. Decent wave clear at level 1.

Invoker.laning_tips: Quas-Wex Invoker: Cold Snap + EMP for mana burn. Quas-Exort: Forge Spirits + Cold Snap for lane dominance. Alacrity with Exort instances gives last-hit advantage. Always be invoking the right spells for the situation. Cold Snap is the strongest laning spell.
Invoker.level1_note: Only 1 orb instance at level 1 — cannot invoke any meaningful spell combo. Extremely weak level 1 fighter.

Zeus.laning_tips: Arc Lightning last hits and harasses simultaneously but drains mana fast. Lightning Bolt deals high single-target damage. Thundergod's Wrath at 6 hits all enemies globally — use to finish low HP targets or provide vision. Static Field passive deals percentage HP damage with each spell.
Zeus.level1_note: Arc Lightning provides low-CD AoE magic damage but burns through mana quickly.

Sniper.laning_tips: Use extreme attack range to harass safely. Shrapnel provides area slow and damage — use for rune control and wave push. Headshot passive procs give bonus damage and slow. Assassinate at 6 finishes low HP targets from long range. Position far back in fights.
Sniper.level1_note: Shrapnel provides area slow and damage but low immediate impact at level 1.

Dragon Knight.laning_tips: Dragon Blood provides high HP regen making you very hard to push out of lane. Breathe Fire nukes the wave and reduces enemy attack damage. Elder Dragon Form at 6 gives ranged attack with effects — push towers aggressively. Mid-game is your strongest timing — push with team.
Dragon Knight.level1_note: Breathe Fire provides AoE magic damage + attack damage reduction. Good base stats as Strength hero.

Huskar.laning_tips: Burning Spears deal stacking damage over time — keep attacking the same target. Inner Fire disarms and knocks back enemies. Berserker's Blood gives attack speed and magic resistance as HP drops. Life Break at 6 slows and nukes based on current HP. Armlet toggling is essential.
Huskar.level1_note: Burning Spears at level 1 deal stacking damage with no mana cost — dominant in lane from level 1.

Broodmother.laning_tips: Insatiable Hunger gives attack damage and lifesteal for trades. Spin Web provides movement speed and free pathing in the web area. Spawn Spiderlings at 6 hatches spiders from a unit that dies under its effect — build the army on creeps, then dominate your lane and push towers with spiders.
Broodmother.level1_note: Insatiable Hunger gives bonus attack damage and lifesteal, but she has no nuke or disable at level 1.

Outworld Destroyer.laning_tips: Arcane Orb deals bonus pure damage based on your mana pool — build intelligence items. Astral Imprisonment banishes target and steals intelligence. Essence Flux restores mana on spell cast. Sanity's Eclipse at 6 deals damage based on mana difference.
Outworld Destroyer.level1_note: Arcane Orb deals decent damage based on mana pool but costs mana per attack.

weaknesses: Reaper's Scythe can be blocked by Linken's
Necrophos.laning_tips: Death Pulse heals you and damages enemies — spam it for sustain and harass. Heartstopper Aura passively drains enemy HP — they lose HP just by standing near you. Ghost Shroud makes you ethereal with amplified healing. Reaper's Scythe kills low HP targets and adds respawn time.
Necrophos.level1_note: Death Pulse provides AoE damage and self-heal — decent sustain in level 1 trades.

weaknesses: If any Meepo clone dies, all die
Highest mechanical skill requirement in the game
Meepo.laning_tips: Earthbind roots enemies in an area — chain nets for permanent lockdown. Poof teleports a clone to another and deals AoE damage — Blink + Poof combo is devastating. Ransack provides lifesteal on attacks. Micro all clones to farm different camps simultaneously for level advantage.
Meepo.level1_note: Earthbind provides a root but no damage. Single Meepo is weak at level 1.

weaknesses: Falls off in tankiness late game
Axe.laning_tips: Stand in enemy creep waves to proc Counter Helix — this is your main laning tool. Battle Hunger burns enemies and slows them while preventing blink. After Blink Dagger, initiate with Berserker's Call into Counter Helix. Culling Blade executes low HP targets and gives team speed.
Axe.level1_note: Counter Helix is an AoE physical passive — procs frequently when surrounded in level 1 fights, dealing high damage.

weaknesses: Spear must hit a tree/cliff for stun
Arena of Blood has long cooldown
Mars.laning_tips: Spear of Mars skewers the first enemy hit — stuns if they hit terrain. God's Rebuke is a wide crit cone that slows. Bulwark blocks damage from the front. Arena of Blood at 6 traps enemies and blocks projectiles from outside. Blink + Spear into Arena is the combo.
Mars.level1_note: God's Rebuke is a wide AoE crit with slow — very strong in level 1 skirmishes.

weaknesses: Hoof Stomp is short range and slow animation
Centaur Warrunner.laning_tips: Retaliate returns damage when attacked — punishes melee heroes who hit you. Hoof Stomp is a close-range AoE stun. Double Edge nukes enemies but damages yourself. Stampede at 6 gives all allies max movement speed and trampling damage. Blink + Hoof Stomp is the core initiation.
Centaur Warrunner.level1_note: Retaliate returns damage passively — strong in level 1 melee trades. High base HP.

weaknesses: Hookshot can miss or hit creeps
Locked inside Cogs with the target — dangerous vs strong carries
Falls off in damage late game
Clockwerk.laning_tips: Battery Assault hits the nearest enemy repeatedly — very strong in 1v1. Power Cogs trap you and an enemy together — combine with Battery Assault. Rocket Flare gives global vision and harassment. Hookshot at 6 provides long-range initiation into Cogs + Battery combo.
Clockwerk.level1_note: Battery Assault deals repeated ministuns and damage — dominant in isolated 1v1 level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Wall of Replica illusions scale with enemy items — less effective vs low-damage heroes
Dark Seer.laning_tips: Ion Shell on your own creeps to push the wave and harass enemies simultaneously. Surge gives max movement speed to an ally for escape or chase. Vacuum groups enemies together — combos with Wall of Replica. Wall at 6 creates illusions of enemies that pass through it.
Dark Seer.level1_note: Ion Shell provides AoE damage over time — good for pushing but limited direct fight impact.

Slardar.laning_tips: Bash of the Deep stuns on every few attacks — strong in extended trades. Guardian Sprint gives massive move speed for chasing and escaping. Slithereen Crush is an AoE stun around you. Corrosive Haze at 6 reduces armor massively and provides true sight — use on key targets.
Slardar.level1_note: Guardian Sprint gives speed but no damage. Bash needs multiple attacks. Average level 1.

weaknesses: Losing Duels gives permanent damage to the enemy
Press the Attack can be purged
Legion Commander.laning_tips: Overwhelming Odds damages based on number of units in the area — strong against summons and creep waves. Press the Attack dispels debuffs and gives movement speed + HP regen. Moment of Courage gives lifesteal procs. Duel at 6 forces a 1v1 — winning gives permanent damage bonus.
Legion Commander.level1_note: Overwhelming Odds deals damage based on units in the area — strong in level 1 group fights.

power_spikes: Level 6 (Doom — the target cannot cast spells or be healed)
Doom.laning_tips: Devour consumes a creep for gold and its ability — choose wisely (Alpha Wolf crit, Centaur stun, etc). Scorched Earth provides AoE damage and self-healing. Infernal Blade is a ministun with %HP burn on attack. Doom at 6 completely disables one enemy — use on the highest impact target.
Doom.level1_note: Devour is useful for economy but no combat value. Scorched Earth provides some damage and regen.

Night Stalker.laning_tips: Survive until first night at 5:00 — then you become extremely powerful. Void deals damage and slows (ministun at night). Crippling Fear silences in AoE at night. Hunter in the Night gives attack and move speed at night. Dark Ascension at 6 grants flying vision, bonus damage, and turns it to night.
Night Stalker.level1_note: Void provides slow but Night Stalker is weak during daytime at level 1.

weaknesses: Boar and Hawks are easily killed
Wild Axes are slow and dodgeable
Beastmaster.laning_tips: Wild Axes deal damage on the way out and back — hit enemies with both passes. Summon Razorback calls a boar whose attacks slow; Summon Raptors calls two hawks that dive at enemies, damaging and rooting them. Inner Beast aura gives attack speed to allies. Primal Roar at 6 is the best single-target stun in the game — goes through BKB.
Beastmaster.level1_note: Wild Axes provide decent AoE damage but are slow-moving projectiles.

weaknesses: Epicenter has a long cast point — interruptible
Sand King.laning_tips: Burrowstrike stuns in a line and repositions you. Sand Storm makes you invisible and deals AoE damage — use it to farm and survive. Caustic Finale causes enemies killed to explode. Epicenter at 6 pulses AoE damage — cast it from fog, then Blink + Burrowstrike in.
Sand King.level1_note: Burrowstrike provides a short-range stun — decent for level 1 fights.

Tidehunter.laning_tips: Kraken Shell blocks damage and purges debuffs after taking enough damage — very hard to harass out of lane. Anchor Smash reduces enemy attack damage and deals AoE. Gush reduces armor and slows. Ravage at 6 is a massive AoE stun — Blink + Ravage wins teamfights.
Tidehunter.level1_note: Anchor Smash provides AoE physical damage + attack damage reduction. Strong base stats — powerful in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Vulnerable from the front — Bristleback passive only works from behind
Bristleback.laning_tips: Turn your back to enemies to reduce damage taken via Bristleback passive, which also fires Quill Sprays. Viscous Nasal Goo stacks armor reduction and slow. Quill Spray stacks deal increasing damage on repeated hits. Warpath at 6 gives damage and speed per spell cast — keep spamming.
Bristleback.level1_note: Viscous Nasal Goo provides slow + armor reduction but needs stacks to be effective.

weaknesses: Useless without mana — mana burn destroys him
Low damage without Reactive Armor stacks
Timbersaw.laning_tips: Reactive Armor stacks give HP regen and armor when attacked — very hard to push out of lane. Whirling Death deals pure damage near trees and reduces primary stat. Timber Chain latches to trees for mobility and escape. Chakram at 6 slows and damages in an area. Very strong against melee STR heroes.
Timbersaw.level1_note: Reactive Armor provides stacking regen and armor — decent sustain at level 1 but no fight contribution.

weaknesses: Eidolons are easily cleared by AoE
Enigma.laning_tips: Demonic Summoning creates Eidolons at the cost of health — use to push lane and jungle simultaneously. Malefice repeats stuns on a target. Midnight Pulse deals %HP damage in an area. Black Hole at 6 is the ultimate teamfight spell — combo with Midnight Pulse for massive damage.
Enigma.level1_note: Eidolons can be summoned but are easily killed by AoE — limited level 1 fight contribution.

Underlord.laning_tips: Firestorm rains fire in waves — zone enemies and farm waves simultaneously. Pit of Malice roots enemies in an area periodically. Atrophy Aura reduces enemy attack damage and gives you bonus damage from nearby deaths. Fiend's Gate at 6 provides global team teleportation.
Underlord.level1_note: Firestorm provides AoE damage but is slow. Atrophy Aura reduces enemy damage passively.

weaknesses: Rolling Thunder can be interrupted by roots
Swashbuckle direction is fixed once cast
Pangolier.laning_tips: Swashbuckle dashes forward with four quick attacks — procs item effects. Shield Crash gives damage reduction per hero hit. Lucky Shot procs an attack speed slow and armor reduction. Rolling Thunder at 6 turns you into a ball that stuns and knocks back on contact — bounces off walls.
Pangolier.level1_note: Swashbuckle provides some burst damage but limited at level 1 without items.

weaknesses: Large hitbox makes him easy to target
Primal Beast.laning_tips: Onslaught charges in a direction — stuns and damages on impact. Trample deals AoE damage while moving. Uproar stacks give bonus damage and a damage-reducing roar. Pulverize at 6 grabs and repeatedly slams an enemy — goes through BKB. Use Blink to get in range for Pulverize.
Primal Beast.level1_note: Onslaught provides a stun with good damage. High base strength makes level 1 fights favorable.

Razor.laning_tips: Static Link steals enemy attack damage over time — maintain the link as long as possible. Plasma Field pulses outward and back dealing AoE damage. Storm Surge provides passive move speed. Eye of the Storm at 6 strikes nearby enemies with armor reduction. Stand in the middle of fights with BKB.
Razor.level1_note: Plasma Field provides AoE damage. Static Link steals attack damage in 1v1. Decent level 1 fighting.

weaknesses: Falls off in damage late game
Batrider.laning_tips: Sticky Napalm stacks amplify all your damage and slow movement/turn rate. Firefly lets you fly over terrain dealing AoE damage. Flamebreak knocks enemies back. Lasso at 6 grabs and drags an enemy — Blink in, Lasso, drag them to your team. One of the best initiators in the game.
Batrider.level1_note: Sticky Napalm stacks provide damage amplification but need multiple stacks to be impactful.

weaknesses: Reverse Polarity has short range — needs Blink
Magnus.laning_tips: Shockwave is a long-range nuke for farming and harass. Empower gives cleave and bonus damage to yourself or an allied carry — always keep it on your carry. Skewer repositions enemies toward your team. Reverse Polarity at 6 is a massive AoE stun — Blink + RP wins teamfights.
Magnus.level1_note: Shockwave provides ranged AoE damage — decent level 1 harass.

weaknesses: Earth Splitter has long delay — easy to dodge
Astral Spirit must hit heroes for bonus damage
Elder Titan.laning_tips: Astral Spirit passes through units dealing damage and returning bonus damage and move speed per hero hit. Echo Stomp channels then puts nearby units to sleep. Natural Order aura removes base armor and magic resistance. Earth Splitter at 6 splits the ground in a line — combos with sleep.
Elder Titan.level1_note: Astral Spirit provides damage and scouting but requires good positioning.

weaknesses: Weak when Primal Split is on cooldown
Requires micro skills for split pandas
Brewmaster.laning_tips: Thunder Clap slows attack and move speed in AoE. Cinder Brew causes enemies to take bonus damage and ignite if hit by fire. Drunken Brawler switches between stances: Earth (armor, magic resistance), Storm (evasion, movement speed) and Fire (attack speed, crit). Primal Split at 6 splits you into three elemental pandas — control them to disable and damage.
Brewmaster.level1_note: Thunder Clap provides AoE slow and damage — decent level 1 fighting.

weaknesses: Treants are easily cleared by AoE
Sprout is dispelled or destroyed by tangos/quelling
Squishy and no escape if Teleportation is on cooldown
Nature's Prophet.laning_tips: Teleportation gives global presence — split push lanes, join fights, return to farm. Sprout traps enemies in a ring of trees. Nature's Call summons treants for pushing and damage. Wrath of Nature at 6 bounces globally dealing increasing damage. Focus on farm efficiency and split pushing.
Nature's Prophet.level1_note: Nature's Call treants provide some damage and body blocking — average level 1.

weaknesses: Wolves can be killed for gold
Lycan.laning_tips: Summon Wolves provides two wolves for scouting, harassment, and damage. Howl gives damage bonus to all allies globally. Feral Impulse gives bonus damage and HP regen. Shapeshift at 6 gives max movement speed, crit chance, and bonus HP. Push towers with wolves and summons.
Lycan.level1_note: Summon Wolves provides extra units for fighting and scouting at level 1.

weaknesses: Celestial Hammer has slow travel time
Solar Guardian channel can be interrupted
Dawnbreaker.laning_tips: Starbreaker is a three-hit combo that stuns on the final slam — hit creeps and heroes alike. Celestial Hammer throws a projectile that you can converge back to. Luminosity heals allies on empowered attacks. Solar Guardian at 6 channels then teleports to an ally, healing and stunning on landing.
Dawnbreaker.level1_note: Starbreaker provides AoE damage and a stun on the third hit — strong level 1 fighting.

Largo.laning_tips: Use your abilities to zone enemies and secure farm in the offlane. Look for opportunities to trade with enemy carry using your strength advantage. Coordinate with your support for kill setups. Build aura items to support your team in mid-game fights.
Largo.level1_note: Strength hero with decent base stats — average level 1 contribution.

Lion.laning_tips: Earth Spike + Hex provides massive disable duration. Mana Drain solves mana issues and can drain enemy mana. Finger of Death at 6 gives enormous single-target burst. Stack disables for kill setups — Earth Spike into Hex into ally follow-up. Position carefully — very squishy.
Lion.level1_note: Earth Spike provides AoE stun — decent disable for level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Hook requires prediction and can miss
Pudge.laning_tips: Meat Hook is a game-changing skillshot — predict enemy movement paths. Rot provides AoE slow and damage but hurts yourself too. Flesh Heap gives passive magic resistance and STR from kills. Dismember at 6 + Rot deals massive damage. Hook from fog of war for best results.
Pudge.level1_note: Rot provides AoE sustained damage + slow. Strength hero with good base stats — very strong in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Useless without Blink Dagger for initiation
Earthshaker.laning_tips: Fissure provides a long-range AoE stun + terrain block — use for kills and escape. Enchant Totem gives bonus damage on next attack for last-hitting. Aftershock stuns in AoE after each spell. Echo Slam at 6 devastates grouped enemies. Farm Blink Dagger by pulling and stacking.
Earthshaker.level1_note: Fissure provides long-range AoE stun + terrain block — extremely strong disable in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Low impact if stealing bad spells
Requires high game knowledge and mechanical skill
Rubick.laning_tips: Telekinesis lifts then drops a target stunning the area. Fade Bolt reduces attack damage on enemies it bounces through. Arcane Supremacy amplifies stolen spells. Spell Steal at 6 copies the last spell an enemy cast — watch for high-value steals like Black Hole or Ravage.
Rubick.level1_note: Telekinesis provides single-target lift + landing stun — some control in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Supernova egg can be destroyed by right-clicks
Phoenix.laning_tips: Fire Spirits reduce enemy attack speed massively — throw them in trades. Icarus Dive damages and slows in an arc and returns you. Sun Ray fires a beam that costs Phoenix health, dealing %HP damage and healing allies. Supernova at 6 turns you into an egg that stuns on hatching — enemy must hit egg to stop it.
Phoenix.level1_note: Fire Spirits provide AoE attack speed slow — decent harassment but cost HP.

weaknesses: No hard disable without tree setup
Hoodwink.laning_tips: Acorn Shot bounces and plants a tree — use it to set up Bushwhack stuns near trees. Bushwhack stuns enemies near trees. Scurry grants evasion and tree-walking. Sharpshooter at 6 charges a long-range nuke that slows and breaks. Utilize tree-heavy terrain for maximum effectiveness.
Hoodwink.level1_note: Acorn Shot provides physical damage and brief slow — decent for level 1 harass.

weaknesses: Snowball commits you — can lead to bad fights
Falls off in damage without items
Tusk.laning_tips: Ice Shards creates a barrier of ice that blocks movement — trap enemies against terrain. Snowball rolls toward a target gathering allies — provides brief invulnerability. Tag Team slows enemies and adds bonus damage. Walrus Punch at 6 is a massive crit that slows.
Tusk.level1_note: Tag Team or Ice Shards provide strong level 1 fighting — good base damage as Strength hero.

weaknesses: Squishy and melee — risky to trade
Falls off in damage late game
Bounty Hunter.laning_tips: Jinada provides bonus damage on a cooldown — walk up, hit, walk away. Shadow Walk gives invisibility for positioning and escape. Shuriken Toss is a ranged nuke that bounces to Tracked targets. Track at 6 gives vision and bonus gold on kill for your whole team — track every enemy before fights.
Bounty Hunter.level1_note: Jinada provides bonus damage on hit — very strong level 1 harass on a cooldown.

Earth Spirit.laning_tips: Boulder Smash kicks a remnant or enemy. Rolling Boulder rolls toward a target — hits harder through a remnant. Geomagnetic Grip silences if pulled through a remnant. Magnetize at 6 applies a refreshing DoT. Combo: place remnant, kick it to stun, roll in, grip to silence. Manage remnant charges carefully.
Earth Spirit.level1_note: Boulder Smash provides a stun via remnant but requires precise execution.

weaknesses: Sacred Arrow is a slow skillshot — easy to dodge
Needs levels and items to deal damage
Mirana.laning_tips: Sacred Arrow stuns for up to 5 seconds based on travel distance — throw from fog for max duration. Starstorm deals AoE damage with a secondary hit on the closest target. Leap provides escape and attack/move speed buff. Moonlight Shadow at 6 gives team-wide invisibility. Flexible as support or core.
Mirana.level1_note: Sacred Arrow provides a potential long stun but requires max range and accuracy.

Nyx Assassin.laning_tips: Impale is a line stun — use from fog for surprise. Mana Burn damages based on enemy intelligence — devastating against INT heroes. Spiked Carapace reflects and stuns the next damage source. Vendetta at 6 gives long invisibility with bonus damage on break — roam and gank.
Nyx Assassin.level1_note: Impale provides an AoE stun — decent level 1 disable.

weaknesses: Shadow Realm has limited attack window
Dark Willow.laning_tips: Bramble Maze creates a field of roots — zone enemies or trap them. Shadow Realm makes you untargetable and charges a powerful attack. Cursed Crown stuns after a delay. Bedlam at 6 sends Jex to attack nearby enemies rapidly. Terrorize fears all enemies in an area.
Dark Willow.level1_note: Bramble Maze provides area denial with root potential — decent level 1 zoning.

weaknesses: Dispose needs an ally or enemy to vault off of
Bodyguard only refills its barrier while she attacks heroes
Marci.laning_tips: Dispose throws an enemy behind you and slows — use it to reposition enemies into your tower or allies. Rebound dashes to a unit and stuns nearby enemies on landing. Bodyguard gives Marci lifesteal and damage and shares them, with a damage barrier, with an ally. Unleash at 6 gives rapid combo attacks with burst pulses.
Marci.level1_note: Dispose provides a throw + slow — very strong repositioning tool in level 1 fights.

weaknesses: Charge of Darkness is visible on minimap
Low damage output in extended fights
Spirit Breaker.laning_tips: Charge of Darkness runs through the map to bash a target — alert enemies see the icon. Bulldoze grants movement speed and status resistance. Greater Bash procs deal damage based on move speed. Nether Strike at 6 is a short-range teleport strike with bash. Roam constantly and find picks.
Spirit Breaker.level1_note: Charge of Darkness provides global initiation with a bash stun — strong level 1 ganking.

weaknesses: Mortimer Kisses is interruptible and hard to aim
Snapfire.laning_tips: Scatterblast is a close-range shotgun blast dealing bonus damage up close. Firesnap Cookie launches an ally or yourself forward — stuns on landing. Lil' Shredder gives bonus attacks with armor reduction. Mortimer Kisses at 6 launches glob projectiles across the map for area damage and slow.
Snapfire.level1_note: Scatterblast deals high damage at close range — strong level 1 trading and kill potential.

weaknesses: Phantom's Embrace can be destroyed by allies attacking it
Ink Swell requires melee ally to deliver
Soulbind requires two enemies close together
Grimstroke.laning_tips: Stroke of Fate deals more damage the further it travels — harass from max range. Phantom's Embrace latches a phantom that silences — enemies must attack it off. Ink Swell buffs an ally with damage and stuns after delay. Soulbind at 6 links two enemies — all single-target spells hit both.
Grimstroke.level1_note: Stroke of Fate provides long-range AoE damage — decent level 1 poke.

weaknesses: Torrent and Ghostship have long delays — easy to dodge
X Marks the Spot has limited range early
Kunkka.laning_tips: Torrent lifts and stuns after a delay — use X Marks to guarantee it lands. Tidebringer cleaves in a large AoE on the next attack. X Marks the Spot returns a target to their position after delay — combo with Torrent. Ghostship at 6 provides AoE stun and rum buff for allies. Can flex as core or support.
Kunkka.level1_note: Torrent is unreliable without setup. Tidebringer provides one big cleave hit.

Tiny.laning_tips: Avalanche + Toss combo deals massive burst — Toss during Avalanche for double Avalanche damage. Tree Grab gives bonus attack damage and cleave. Grow at 6 gives bonus damage but slows attack speed. Can play as support (burst combo) or carry (Tree Grab farming). Blink + combo kills most heroes.
Tiny.level1_note: Avalanche provides AoE stun and damage — strong in level 1 group fights.

Ringmaster.laning_tips: Use your abilities to control space and set up kills for your lane partner. Harass with ranged attacks and spells. Position carefully in fights to land key abilities. Build utility items to enhance team contribution.
Ringmaster.level1_note: Ranged hero with decent base abilities — average level 1 contribution.

weaknesses: Nether Swap puts you in danger
Vengeful Spirit.laning_tips: Magic Missile is a reliable targeted stun — strong kill setup. Wave of Terror reduces armor in a line and gives vision. Vengeance Aura gives bonus damage to allies. Nether Swap at 6 swaps positions with any unit — save allies or pull enemies out of position. Very versatile support.
Vengeful Spirit.level1_note: Magic Missile provides a reliable single-target stun — decent level 1 disable.

weaknesses: Shackleshot requires unit or tree behind target for stun
Focus Fire deals reduced damage without items
Windranger.laning_tips: Powershot is a long-range nuke that damages in a line — good for harass and securing ranged creeps. Shackleshot stuns for 2+ seconds when it latches to a tree or unit behind the target. Windrun grants evasion and movement speed. Focus Fire at 6 provides maximum attack speed vs one target. Flexible as support or core.
Windranger.level1_note: Powershot provides decent ranged damage. Shackleshot provides stun if latched correctly.

weaknesses: Slowest movement speed in the game
Freezing Field requires channeling and can be interrupted
Crystal Maiden.laning_tips: Arcane Aura provides global mana regen to all allies — one of the best passive support abilities. Crystal Nova + Frostbite combo deals high damage and locks enemies down. Stay behind your carry and provide disables. Freezing Field at 6 is devastating but needs BKB or smart positioning.
Crystal Maiden.level1_note: Crystal Nova provides AoE slow and magic damage — effective in level 1 skirmishes.

weaknesses: Chaotic Offering has extremely long cooldown
Warlock.laning_tips: Shadow Word heals allies or damages enemies over time — strong lane sustain. Fatal Bonds links enemies so damage to one spreads to all. Upheaval channels a massive slow. Chaotic Offering at 6 stuns in AoE and summons a Golem — Refresher for double Golem is game-winning.
Warlock.level1_note: Shadow Word provides heal or damage over time. Fatal Bonds also viable. Some teamfight contribution.

Shadow Shaman.laning_tips: Hex + Shackles provides over 5 seconds of disable chain — almost guaranteed kill with ally follow-up. Ether Shock nukes the wave and enemies. Mass Serpent Ward at 6 melts towers — push immediately after winning a fight. Position carefully as you are immobile during Shackles.
Shadow Shaman.level1_note: Ether Shock provides AoE magic damage — decent damage output at level 1.

Witch Doctor.laning_tips: Paralyzing Cask bounces between enemies — devastating in dual lanes with more bounce targets. Voodoo Restoration heals in AoE. Maledict amplifies damage taken over time — combo with burst damage. Death Ward at 6 deals massive pure damage but needs protection while channeling.
Witch Doctor.level1_note: Paralyzing Cask provides multi-target bouncing stun — extremely strong in level 1 fights.

power_spikes: Level 6 (Nothl Projection — empowered spells as an invulnerable spirit)
weaknesses: Shallow Grave doesn't prevent damage, only death
Dazzle.laning_tips: Poison Touch slows and deals damage over time — attack the poisoned target to refresh it and deepen the slow. Shadow Wave heals allies and damages enemies near them. Shallow Grave prevents an ally from dying for a short duration. Every spell applies Weave, which adds armor to allies and takes it from enemies. Nothl Projection at 6 lets Dazzle cast as an invulnerable spirit while his body stays behind.
Dazzle.level1_note: Poison Touch provides strong harass with slow and damage over time — strong level 1 trading.

weaknesses: Ice Path stun has a long wind-up
Jakiro.laning_tips: Dual Breath provides AoE slow and damage with both fire and ice. Ice Path creates a line of ice that stuns after a delay — predict enemy movement. Liquid Fire reduces attack speed and damages towers. Macropyre at 6 creates a long line of fire dealing massive AoE damage.
Jakiro.level1_note: Dual Breath provides AoE slow and DoT — decent level 1 area damage.

weaknesses: Chain Frost needs grouped enemies to bounce
Lich.laning_tips: Frost Blast nukes and slows in AoE — harass and secure ranged creeps. Frost Shield provides damage reduction and damages nearby enemies. Sinister Gaze channels a hypnotize that drains mana and pulls enemies. Chain Frost at 6 bounces between grouped enemies dealing massive damage.
Lich.level1_note: Frost Blast provides AoE slow and nuke damage — decent level 1 contribution.

power_spikes: Level 1 (highest base armor in the game)
weaknesses: Melee support — needs to get close to cast
Low mana pool for ability spam
Ogre Magi.laning_tips: Fireblast is a targeted stun. Ignite slows and damages over time at long range. Bloodlust gives attack and move speed to allies. Multicast at 6 gives a chance to cast abilities multiple times. Highest base armor in the game — trade aggressively in melee range. Very tanky for a support.
Ogre Magi.level1_note: Highest base armor in the game (8+). Ignite provides ranged slow + DoT. Very strong in level 1 melee trades.

power_spikes: Aghanim's Scepter (mutes items in Static Storm)
Glimpse at level 4 (sends enemy back 4 seconds)
Disruptor.laning_tips: Thunder Strike provides vision and recurring damage. Glimpse sends an enemy back to where they were seconds ago — punish TPs and retreats. Kinetic Field traps enemies in a circle. Static Storm at 6 silences all enemies in an area. Aghs adds item mute — devastating combo with Kinetic Field.
Disruptor.level1_note: Thunder Strike provides recurring damage and vision — decent level 1 harass.

Ancient Apparition.laning_tips: Cold Feet stuns if the enemy doesn't move away in time — pair with ally slows for guaranteed stun. Ice Vortex slows and amplifies magic damage. Chilling Touch gives bonus magic damage on attacks. Ice Blast at 6 is a global nuke that prevents all healing — devastating against sustain heroes.
Ancient Apparition.level1_note: Cold Feet can stun but enemy can walk away. Chilling Touch adds some harass damage.

weaknesses: Nightmare can accidentally save enemies or disable allies
Bane.laning_tips: Brain Sap is a pure damage nuke that heals you — strong trading. Nightmare puts a target to sleep — use for setup or self-defense but be careful not to save enemies. Enfeeble reduces enemy status resistance. Fiend's Grip at 6 is one of the longest disables and goes through BKB.
Bane.level1_note: Brain Sap provides pure damage and self-heal — decent level 1 trading.

power_spikes: Level 1 (highest base damage in the game)
weaknesses: Living Armor's damage block shrinks with every hit it absorbs
Melee support with no gap closer
Treant Protector.laning_tips: Highest base damage in the game — right-click harass is devastating at level 1. Nature's Grasp creates vines that slow and damage. Living Armor heals and blocks damage globally on allies or towers. Leech Seed slows and heals. Overgrowth at 6 roots all nearby enemies.
Treant Protector.level1_note: Highest base damage in the game (over 80). Leech Seed provides slow and heal. Dominant in level 1 melee trades.

weaknesses: Falls off significantly after laning phase
Undying.laning_tips: Decay steals Strength from enemies — spam it to become tankier while weakening them. Soul Rip damages enemies or heals allies based on nearby units. Tombstone spawns zombies that slow enemies — dominant in lane fights. Flesh Golem at 6 amplifies damage on nearby enemies. Win your lane hard because you fall off later.
Undying.level1_note: Decay steals STR making you tankier and enemies squishier — one of the strongest level 1 heroes.

weaknesses: Chakra Magic on enemies can help them too
Keeper of the Light.laning_tips: Illuminate channels a blast of light that deals massive AoE damage — clear waves and harass. Blinding Light knocks back and blinds enemies. Chakra Magic restores mana to allies. Solar Bind slows and lowers magic resistance. Will-O-Wisp at 6 hypnotizes enemies in an area — powerful teamfight control.
Keeper of the Light.level1_note: Illuminate requires charging but deals good AoE damage. Decent zoning at level 1.

power_spikes: Heart of Tarrasque timing (on tethered carry)
weaknesses: Relocate can strand you if mistimed
Io.laning_tips: Tether links you to an ally, sharing regen and granting movement speed. Spirits orbit you dealing damage. Overcharge provides bonus attack speed and spell amplification to you and tethered ally. Relocate at 6 teleports you and tethered ally anywhere on the map — gank or escape globally.
Io.level1_note: Tether provides movement speed boost but Io has minimal solo fight impact at level 1.

weaknesses: Purifying Flames heals enemies if not comboed correctly
False Promise delays damage — ally can still die after
Oracle.laning_tips: Fortune's End dispels and roots. Fate's Edict disarms a target and grants 100% magic resistance. Purifying Flames nukes then heals — use Fate's Edict on an ally first to block the damage, or Fortune's End to purge the heal from enemies. False Promise at 6 delays all damage and doubles healing on an ally — the ultimate save spell.
Oracle.level1_note: Fortune's End provides a root and dispel — decent level 1 lockdown.

power_spikes: Level 6 (Winter's Curse — enemies attack their own ally)
weaknesses: Winter's Curse can save the target briefly
Cold Embrace makes ally unable to act
Limited impact if enemies stay spread
Winter Wyvern.laning_tips: Arctic Burn gives flying movement and bonus attack range with %HP burn. Splinter Blast hits a target then splinters to nearby enemies — great wave clear. Cold Embrace encases an ally in ice, healing them but making them unable to act. Winter's Curse at 6 taunts enemies to attack their own ally.
Winter Wyvern.level1_note: Arctic Burn provides bonus range and %HP damage — decent level 1 harass.

Chen.laning_tips: Holy Persuasion converts jungle creeps — each has unique abilities (Centaur stun, Satyr purge, etc). Penitence slows enemies and amplifies damage. Divine Favor heals and gives bonus regen. Hand of God at 6 heals all allied heroes globally. Dominate key creeps early and push with your army.
Chen.level1_note: Holy Persuasion converts a creep at level 1 — strong if you get a centaur or hellbear stun.

weaknesses: Mist Coil costs HP to cast
Abaddon.laning_tips: Mist Coil heals allies or damages enemies but costs your own HP. Aphotic Shield absorbs damage and explodes — also dispels debuffs from allies. Curse of Avernus slows enemies and speeds allies on attack. Borrowed Time at 6 converts all damage to healing when HP drops low — auto-activates.
Abaddon.level1_note: Mist Coil provides heal or damage but costs HP. Aphotic Shield provides a dispel and damage absorption.

weaknesses: Melee support — needs to be in the fight
Guardian Angel countered by diffusal or dispels
Omniknight.laning_tips: Purification heals an ally and damages nearby enemies — use offensively by healing an ally standing next to enemies. Repel grants an ally debuff immunity and HP regen. Hammer of Purity gives bonus pure damage on attacks. Guardian Angel at 6 grants physical damage immunity to allies.
Omniknight.level1_note: Purification provides heal + AoE damage — decent level 1 trading near creeps.

weaknesses: Global Silence countered by BKB and Manta
Silencer.laning_tips: Arcane Curse damages enemies who cast spells — punishes spell-heavy laners. Last Word damages and silences the target when it casts a spell or when its timer runs out. Glaives of Wisdom deal bonus magical damage based on Intelligence. Global Silence at 6 silences all enemies on the map. Steal INT permanently with kills/assists.
Silencer.level1_note: Arcane Curse provides damage and discourages spell usage — decent level 1 harass.

power_spikes: Aghanim's Scepter (3 charges of Demonic Purge)
weaknesses: Shadow Poison needs stacks to deal damage
Shadow Demon.laning_tips: Disruption banishes a target and creates two illusions — use to save allies or set up ganks. Shadow Poison stacks damage — 5 stacks deals massive burst on release. Disseminate spreads a portion of damage taken by a target to nearby enemies. Demonic Purge at 6 continuously slows and purges.
Shadow Demon.level1_note: Disruption provides a banish and creates illusions — utility at level 1 but no damage.

weaknesses: Gravekeeper's Cloak charges need time to replenish
Visage.laning_tips: Grave Chill steals attack and move speed from an enemy. Soul Assumption charges from nearby damage — release when fully charged for burst. Gravekeeper's Cloak provides damage reduction layers. Familiars at 6 deal massive stun damage when dropping Stone Form — micro them to stun and chase.
Visage.level1_note: Grave Chill steals attack/move speed — decent level 1 trading tool.

power_spikes: Rod of Atos timing (root + Mystic Flare)
weaknesses: Mystic Flare damage splits between heroes in the area
Skywrath Mage.laning_tips: Arcane Bolt scales with Intelligence — gets stronger as you level. Concussive Shot targets nearest hero with a slow. Ancient Seal silences and amplifies magic damage. Mystic Flare at 6 rains damage in an area — combo with Rod of Atos root for guaranteed full damage on one target.
Skywrath Mage.level1_note: Arcane Bolt provides scaling magic damage but low at level 1.

power_spikes: Level 3 (Plague Wards + Venomous Gale zone control)
weaknesses: Poison Nova cannot kill — needs follow-up damage
Plague Wards give gold to enemies
Venomancer.laning_tips: Venomous Gale slows and deals DoT — strong harass in lane. Poison Sting applies a slowing poison on attacks. Plague Wards provide vision and zone control — place them strategically. Poison Nova at 6 applies massive AoE DoT but cannot kill by itself. Strong lane dominator and teamfight presence.
Venomancer.level1_note: Venomous Gale provides AoE slow and DoT — decent level 1 zone control.

power_spikes: Level 6 (Impetus — pure damage based on distance)
weaknesses: Enchanted creeps expire and need re-enchanting
Enchantress.laning_tips: Enchant converts jungle creeps or slows enemy heroes. Nature's Attendants heal you and allies with wisps. Untouchable slows enemy attack speed massively — punishes right-clickers. Impetus at 6 deals bonus pure damage based on distance — kite from max range for maximum damage.
Enchantress.level1_note: Enchant converts a jungle creep at level 1 — strong laning with a centaur stun or hellbear swipe.

weaknesses: Time Lapse only works on yourself (without Aghs)
Weaver.laning_tips: Shukuchi gives max movement speed and invisibility for a short burst — harass and escape. Geminate Attack double-hits on the first attack. The Swarm sends beetles that latch on and reduce armor. Time Lapse at 6 reverses your position and HP to 5 seconds ago. Can flex as carry or support.
Weaver.level1_note: Shukuchi provides invisibility and max speed — decent harass tool at level 1.

weaknesses: Dependent on Skeleton Walk — countered by detection
Clinkz.laning_tips: Strafe gives bonus attack speed and dodge chance. Searing Arrows add bonus fire damage to attacks. Skeleton Walk provides invisibility and movement speed. Burning Barrage fires arrows in a line. More commonly played as a damage dealer but can roam with invisibility for ganks.
Clinkz.level1_note: Searing Arrows provide bonus damage on attacks — decent level 1 harass from range.

weaknesses: Split Earth has long delay — hard to land
Needs to be in close range for maximum damage
Leshrac.laning_tips: Split Earth stuns in AoE after a delay — needs setup or prediction. Diabolic Edict deals pure damage to nearby units and buildings — melts towers. Lightning Storm chains between enemies. Pulse Nova at 6 deals AoE damage per second. Can flex as mid or support — strong tower pusher.
Leshrac.level1_note: Split Earth provides AoE stun but the delay makes it unreliable at level 1.

weaknesses: Mines are countered by detection and summons
Blast Off costs 20% of current HP
Forces a passive playstyle that lacks teamfight presence
Techies.laning_tips: Sticky Bomb attaches to enemies and explodes after a delay with a slow. Reactive Tazer disarms attackers. Blast Off leaps and stuns in AoE but costs a fifth of your current HP. Proximity Mines deal massive damage — place them in common pathways. Control areas of the map with mine placements.
Techies.level1_note: Proximity Mine requires setup time and enemies walking into it. Low level 1 fight contribution.

weaknesses: Extremely low HP pool and armor
Pugna.laning_tips: Nether Blast damages buildings and heroes in AoE — strong push. Decrepify makes a target ethereal (immune to physical, takes bonus magic damage). Nether Ward punishes spell casters by zapping them when they cast. Life Drain at 6 channels a HP drain — use Decrepify first for amplified drain damage.
Pugna.level1_note: Nether Blast provides AoE damage that hits buildings — decent level 1 push and damage.

power_spikes: Level 6 (permanent invisibility via Cloak and Dagger)
weaknesses: Completely countered by detection (Dust, Sentry, Gem)
Smoke Screen is avoidable by walking out
Riki.laning_tips: Smoke Screen silences and causes miss chance in an area — strong zone control. Blink Strike teleports behind a target dealing damage. Tricks of the Trade hits all enemies in AoE from invulnerability. Cloak and Dagger provides permanent invisibility and backstab bonus damage. Buy detection against detection.
Riki.level1_note: No permanent invisibility at level 1. Blink Strike provides a gap close but limited damage.

Viper.laning_tips: Poison Attack is one of the strongest lane harass abilities — apply it constantly. Nethertoxin deals damage and slows attack speed in an area. Corrosive Skin makes melee heroes reluctant to trade. Viper Strike at 6 massively slows a target. Dominate lane then convert to push and objectives.
Viper.level1_note: Poison Attack provides slow and DoT with no mana cost — dominant level 1 lane harass.
